notes.notes:
I am thrilled to announce that 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE is now available! Huge thanks for all the wishlists and words of support; it really means the world to me. Oh, also - for the next 7 days, you can buy the game with a 10% launch discount!

Please enjoy the game and, if you like it, please leave a review (this really helps!) :)
[previewyoutube=25AY3p6rSpA;full][/previewyoutube]

A Few Words About the Game:

Key Features:
[list]
[*] Epic Tower Defense
[*] Stunning Pixel Art
[*] Diverse Heroes & Perks
[*] Endless Mode for Infinite Fun
[/list]
In 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE, players embark on a thrilling tower-defense adventure where strategy and logic are key. Your mission is to defend your castle and its precious riches from relentless waves of monsters. Each wave brings a new challenge, requiring you to place appropriate troops and units in the applicable rows to fend off the invaders.

Thank you again and please keep checking this space over the next few days, I'll be updating a couple of FAQ-type posts, that will explain a bit more about the game.

notes.title: 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE - DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey Gamers!

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has added 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE to their wishlists. Your support is invaluable, and we are truly grateful.

We are thrilled to announce that the 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE DEMO is NOW AVAILABLE for download directly from the Steam store page! 

This demo serves as a vertical slice of the full game experience, providing you with a chance to:
🛡 Choose heroes and perks to battle a variety of monsters.
🏰 Defend your castle against waves of attackers.
🎨 Enjoy the stunning pixel-art views that bring the world of 1BIT CASTLE REMAKE to life.

We appreciate a pro-gamer approach, so it’s important to note that your progress from the demo will be saved! All the perks you've unlocked in the demo will carry over to the full version if you decide to purchase it (please do!) :)

We've designed the demo to give you a comprehensive look at what to expect in the full release. It includes all the heroes and monsters that will be featured in the game. For the purposes of this demo, we've capped the challenge at 10 waves. Successfully defeating the 10th wave will conclude the demo, but remember, the full game will feature an endless mode!

In endless mode, you will face an unending onslaught of foes, with the game's difficulty progressively scaling up. This will provide a constant challenge for those hungry for strategic gameplay.

Thank you again for your continuous support. We are overwhelmed by all the kind words and encouragement. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts and experiences with the demo.

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those defences strong!
